system.description: A lowland order-state where nothing is real until it is written and witnessed. Serrovane settles its disputes by formal challenge, keeps its ledgers in triplicate, and considers a broken oath a more serious crime than the violence that follows it.
system.specialAbility: Its Root Talent is granted free by the character-creation choice: a language, and a Diplomacy bonus toward those who share your Culture that rises with your Proficiency Rank in your Origin.
